title: Editions of the Dewey Decimal Classification
author: J. P. Comaromi
abstract: A historical study of the Dewey Decimal Classification, its editions, continuing revision, and influence on librarianship.

title: Use Made of Technical Libraries
author: M. Slater
abstract: A study of information use in technical organizations, comparing library documents with personal contacts, desk collections, and oral communication.

title: Two Kinds of Power: An Essay on Bibliographic Control
author: P. Wilson
abstract: An analysis of how organizing writings and bibliographic records affects access to recorded knowledge and scholarly information.

title: Systems Analysis of a University Library
author: M. K. Buckland
abstract: Systems analysis is applied to academic library planning, management, service objectives, and evidence-based decisions in a university.

title: A Library Management Game
author: P. Brophy
abstract: A simulation game supports professional education by modeling library management decisions with mathematical methods and computer assistance.

title: Abstracting Concepts and Methods
author: H. Borko
abstract: Concepts, standards, writing methods, and computer techniques for preparing and evaluating abstracts and automatic text extracts.

title: Academic Library Buildings
author: R. E. Ellsworth
abstract: Guidance for librarians and architects planning, remodeling, and enlarging college and university library buildings.

title: The Academic Library
author: E. I. Farber
abstract: Essays on research libraries, collection development, literature, scholarship, professional reading, and service to students and faculty.

title: Access to Libraries in College
author: R. T. Hyman
abstract: A study of direct shelf access, browsing, classification, reader behavior, and professional ideas about open academic library collections.

title: Acquisition from Developing Regions

title: Federal Report Numbering and Microfiche Readers

title: Evaluation of Ranked Retrieval

title: Construction and Use of a Thesaurus
author: Demonstration record
